description: The Settings window's own IPC surface — deliberately separate from capabilities/default.json's "main" grant (see that file's own description for the narrow-explicit-surface philosophy this follows) rather than just adding "settings" to its windows array: a settings window with the FULL main-window surface (target management, port scans, file read/write, elevation relaunch, etc.) would be needlessly broad for a window that only ever loads/saves the settings file and re-applies the auto-refresh tuning. Scoped to exactly that.
